audit.whatIsWrong: Every row disagrees with its own explanation and with the mirror. Rows 0-2, 4 and 6 read Yorick while whys[0]-[2], whys[5] and whys[6] all hand those stages to Yone; row 3 reads Skill while whys[3] says they remain his; row 4 is the only genuinely even stage and reads Yorick.
audit.why: The mirror set rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 to Yone and row 4 to Skill. Our page currently shows Yorick winning a lane its own text says he loses, and the win rate (47.89%) agrees with the text.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 -> Yone at 3/10; row 4 -> Skill at 5/10. Matched full/content pairs, one chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage described Fate Sealed as a teleport that knocks up your cluster and gave no cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text: he blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls all enemies hit towards him — a pull, not a knockup — 1000 range on 120/100/80s. Whether you can fight after it depends on that timer.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the blink-behind, the pull, the 1000 range and the 120/100/80s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is treated as a dash in spikes[0].text and wants.you[1] ('cage him after his E dash', 'you can't cage what dashes twice'), and the six do/don't bodies are generic filler.
audit.why: Riot's text: his spirit leaves his body behind and, when the ability ends, is forced back to that body, repeating a portion of the damage dealt as a spirit. It is not a dash, and the return point is known in advance — which is exactly what makes Dark Procession work here. E is 22/19/16/13/10s; Mortal Steel is 450 range on 4s and the third stack is the dash-knockup; Spirit Cleave is a 14s shield.
audit.corrected: Both prose fields now describe the snap-back to the body and tell you to cage that spot; the do/don't bodies carry the stack count, the E timer and the return damage.

edits.before: Yone's spike is brutal: Q third-hit Gathering Storm knocks up and dashes, and Spirit Cleave (W) shields him through your ghoul chip. He can Q-in, W-shield the trade, and E Soul Unbound to reset if it goes wrong — you can't cage what dashes twice. Play safe behind minions and don't commit your Maiden into an all-in.
edits.after: Yone's spike is brutal: the third Mortal Steel dashes him in with a knock-up, and Spirit Cleave (W) shields him on 14s through your ghoul chip. Soul Unbound (E) is not a dash — it snaps him back to the body he left behind, so cage that spot instead of chasing. Play behind minions and don't spend Maiden into his all-in.

edits.before: Fate Sealed (R) teleports behind you and knocks up your whole cluster — including through a bad W placement. This is roughly even: if you have Maiden and cage him post-dash you can trade, but he can also just R-engage and delete you before ghouls stack. Respect the all-in unless you're clearly ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed (R) blinks behind the last champion in a 1000-range line and drags everyone it hits toward him, on a 120/100/80s cooldown. Level 6 is roughly even: with Maiden up and a cage on his body you trade back, but a clean R still deletes you before ghouls stack. Respect the all-in unless you're clearly ahead.

edits.after: Cage his body so the E snap-back lands in it

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Cage him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Yone so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Dark Procession is a 20s destructible wall at 600 range — put it on the body he left, not on the spirit, and swarm the return.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mourning Mist cuts his armour and your ghouls sprint at the mark.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks make the third a dash and knock-up — count the stacks.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is 450 range on 4s — he re-enters faster than you cage.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Soul Unbound repeats a share of the spirit's damage on the return — disengage before the snap.
